eligibility: Latest full inventory revision strictly before January 1; unambiguous; CrossingClosed=No, CrossingType=Public, CrossingPosition=At Grade. No current-open filter; purpose retained and not filtered.
tie_policy: Same-date records identical on selected features/eligibility collapse; conflicting same-date latest records exclude the crossing-year.
feature_date_policy: Revision strictly before label year; AADT/train measurements dated in/after label year masked; future gate installation masks gate count and signs/signals; future whistle date masks whistleban; negative numeric sentinels masked.
history_policy: Only reports dated before label year; 1/3/5-year rolling windows; prewindow2009–2013.
limitations: Retrospective reconstruction by reported revision/effective date. Neither inventory nor incident extracts establish when a revision/report first became publicly available; later corrections or reporting delays can remain. Not a real-time validation.

Eligibility is open/public/at-grade in the latest unambiguous pre-January-1 full inventory revision, not a guarantee of actual operation throughout that year. Missing earlier revisions, stale status and within-year closures remain possible.
A report absent from Form 57 is coded zero reports, not proof of no real incident. The target is a positive crossing-year; report counts are not deduplicated physical accidents.
2024 and 2025 are complete calendar years in the retrieved data, but late reports and future source corrections remain possible. The 2026 partial year is excluded.
Annual history is updated through the preceding calendar year, including 2024 reports when scoring 2025. This is annual updating, not a frozen two-year forecast.
The published historical dataset exposes full Major records only. Completeness of minor updates and the original reporting/processing timeline is not established.
Incident-history count and casualty features aggregate unique Form57 reports, not a verified physical-accident identifier; multi-report accidents can inflate these totals.
universe_note: Known IDs in retrieved pre2025 full records; without-prior-revision counts do not distinguish not-yet-existing crossings from missing historical records.
